package main

-- app/mw.go --
package app

import "net/http"

//fabrik:http:middleware global=true requires=ghost
func GhostRequirer(next http.Handler) http.Handler { return next }

//fabrik:http:middleware global=true requires=routed
func RoutedRequirer(next http.Handler) http.Handler { return next }

//fabrik:http:middleware global=true after=routed
func RoutedFollower(next http.Handler) http.Handler { return next }

//fabrik:http:middleware name=routed
func Routed(next http.Handler) http.Handler { return next }

//fabrik:http:middleware name=inner global=true after=*
func Inner(next http.Handler) http.Handler { return next }

//fabrik:http:middleware name=innerchaser global=true after=inner
func InnerChaser(next http.Handler) http.Handler { return next }

//fabrik:http:middleware name=gsession global=true
func GSession(next http.Handler) http.Handler { return next }

//fabrik:http:middleware name=admin requires=auth
func Admin(next http.Handler) http.Handler { return next }

//fabrik:http:middleware name=auth
func Auth(next http.Handler) http.Handler { return next }

//fabrik:http:middleware name=r1 requires=r2
func R1(next http.Handler) http.Handler { return next }

//fabrik:http:middleware name=r2 requires=r1
func R2(next http.Handler) http.Handler { return next }

//fabrik:http:middleware
func BareNoop(next http.Handler) http.Handler { return next }

//fabrik:http GET /admin middleware=admin
func AdminPage(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {}

//fabrik:http GET /home middleware=gsession
func Home(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {}
